title: Underwriting Enablement Manager
description:
**About The Team**
The Senior Specialist, Frontline Support, Enablement empowers Zillow’s sales teams by designing and delivering enablement programs, training, and resources that drive seller effectiveness and business results. This role leads cross-functional initiatives to streamline onboarding, continuous learning, and sales playbooks, ensuring sellers have the tools and knowledge needed to excel. Operating with high autonomy, the Senior Specialist partners across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify gaps, optimize processes, and enhance the adoption and impact of enablement strategies.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Underwriting Enablement Manager owns the role-specific onboarding and continuing education programs for Zillow Home Loans' India-based Credit Specialists. Credit Specialists perform credit file reviews and the training for this role requires deep familiarity with underwriting fundamentals, credit analysis, and ZHL's underwriting tools and decision framework.
  
  
You will design the curriculum, build the content, deliver live training sessions, and keep all materials current as tools, workflows, and credit policies evolve. Training and facilitation expertise is the most critical qualification for this role. Underwriting subject matter knowledge is the operational foundation you build on top of that.
  
  

* Design, build, and own the end-to-end new hire onboarding program for Credit Specialists, covering the full ramp period from Day 1 through independent production.
* Facilitate live training sessions covering credit file review, Encompass and underwriting tools, underwriting decision-making, condition writing, income and liability analysis, and AUS interpretation.
* Build and maintain role-specific SOPs, job aids, Encompass workflow guides, and reference documentation in Highspot.
* Develop and maintain Zillow University (ZU) e-learning courses with embedded knowledge checks.
* Design and coordinate structured shadow and nesting schedules with US-based underwriters, team leads, and senior managers.
* Coach new hires through their ramp; providing feedback on early file reviews, monitoring condition quality, and partnering with team leads on readiness decisions.
* Maintain and update all training materials on a quarterly cadence and when Encompass tools, workflows, or credit policy changes require it.
* Deliver department-level re-enablement training when significant changes roll out; including workflow launches, Encompass enhancements, and new product guidelines.
* Track new hire progress and milestone completion; communicate readiness status to operations leaders and IC managers.
* Partner with the Underwriting Director, senior managers, and team leads, as well as the Fulfillment Enablement team, to prioritize training needs and align the program with operational and quality standards.
* Contribute to broader enablement work including AI tool adoption support, Highspot content validation, and Encompass enhancement communication.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 5+ years in a training, instructional design, facilitation, or learning enablement role.
* Demonstrated ability to design and deliver structured, multi-week onboarding programs in a mortgage or financial services environment.
* Strong content creation skills: you can build SOPs, training decks, job aids, and e-learning courses from scratch without significant support.
* Hands-on mortgage underwriting or credit analysis experience; including working knowledge of credit report review, income calculation, DTI analysis, AUS (DU/LP), and underwriting decision documentation.
* Experience facilitating live virtual training to distributed or global audiences; comfortable running live file reviews and shadow sessions over Zoom.
* Working knowledge of Encompass or a comparable loan origination system.
* Familiarity with Highspot or similar knowledge management and LMS platforms is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills; able to manage multiple roles, programs, and incoming cohorts simultaneously.
* Clear, concise communicator, written and verbal, with the ability to make complex mortgage concepts accessible to new learners.
* Collaborative working style; comfortable building relationships and partnering across time zones with US-based operations leaders and subject matter experts.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Job Title: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Bangalore

Reporting to: Group Chief Executive Officer

Experience Required: 18 to 25 Years (At least 3 to 6 Years as CEO or COO or MD)

Candidates from other cities and from overseas who are open to relocating are welcome.

Compensation: Highly competitive and in line with the seniority of the role - 2.5 to 4.0 Cr.

**Role at a glance**

A promoter-led real estate group is appointing its first professional Chief Executive Officer to run an operating Grade-A office portfolio and lead its next phase of growth.

Title: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Bengaluru (relocation supported; candidates from across India and the Gulf welcome)

Reports to: Promoter / Chairman and the Board

Portfolio: 3.0–5.0 million sq ft of operating and under-development Grade-A office space

Direct reports: Heads of Leasing, Asset & Property Management, Projects, Finance, Legal & Secretarial, HR

Mandate: Full P&L, asset value, capital plan and the professional management of the business

Experience: 20+ years in real estate, with at least 5 years leading a business unit or company

**About the opportunity**

The group has built a portfolio of large Grade-A office campuses leased to multinational and Indian occupiers. Until now the promoter family has run it directly. The next phase needs a seasoned operator who can run the platform on institutional lines while keeping the speed and judgement of a founder-led firm.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's. The CEO will set up the management structure, systems and governance that turn a family-run asset owner into a professionally managed real estate company. That company should be ready for institutional capital, a REIT-style platform or strategic partnerships over time.

The CEO works closely with the promoters as a trusted partner. Strategy and capital decisions are shared; execution and day-to-day leadership sit with the CEO.

**Purpose of the role and what success looks like**

The CEO's job is to grow the value and the income of the portfolio, and to build a leadership team and governance that can run it without the promoters in the day-to-day.

* **First 12 months.**
  Take full charge of operations, leasing and finance. Agree a 5-year business plan and annual budget with the Board. Put the senior team in place, filling gaps where needed. Bring in a monthly MIS, delegation-of-authority matrix and asset-level P&L.
* **Years 2–3.**
  Keep occupancy at or above market for comparable Grade-A stock. Deliver the development pipeline on time and on budget. Refinance or restructure debt to lower the cost of capital. Lift net operating income and asset value through renewals, rent escalations and tenant retention. Get the business ready for institutional investors, with clean title, audited asset-level accounts and compliance in order.
* **Beyond.**
  Lead the group's next growth step, whether new campuses, acquisitions, joint ventures or a listed or private investment platform.

**Key responsibilities**

The CEO owns the business end to end. The responsibilities fall into eight areas.

**1. Strategy and business planning**

* Build and own the 5-year strategy and the annual operating plan for the portfolio, and present both to the Board.
* Set targets for occupancy, rent growth, net operating income, development delivery and return on capital.
* Track the office market (supply, absorption, rentals, occupier demand) and turn it into hold, develop, sell or acquire decisions.
* Spot growth options: new land, joint development agreements, acquisitions of leased assets, and new formats such as flex space or data-centre-ready buildings.

**2. Leasing and occupier relationships**

* Lead the leasing strategy for 3.0–5.0 million sq ft: pre-leasing of new buildings, renewals, expansions and backfilling of vacated space.
* Personally lead the relationships and negotiations with large anchor occupiers and global capability centres.
* Manage relationships with the leasing advisory firms and the broker channel.
* Set rent, escalation, lock-in and fit-out terms that protect long-term asset value, and keep tenant concentration in check.
* Run an occupier experience programme that drives retention and renewals.

**3. Asset and property management**

* Run each building as a profit centre, with its own P&L, capital-expenditure plan and value targets.
* Oversee property and facility management across the campuses: maintenance, security, energy, safety and occupier services, whether in-house or outsourced.
* Plan upgrades and repositioning of older buildings to keep them Grade-A.
* Lead the sustainability agenda: green-building certifications, energy and water efficiency, and ESG reporting expected by multinational occupiers and investors.
* Track and recover common area maintenance (CAM) charges, receivables and service-level performance.

**4. Development and projects**

* Own delivery of the development pipeline, from design brief and approvals through construction to handover.
* Appoint and manage architects, project managers and contractors; hold them to cost, time and quality.
* Make sure new supply matches occupier demand and pre-leasing commitments.
* Work with government bodies on approvals, land use and infrastructure.

**5. Finance, capital and investor readiness**

* Own the P&L, cash flow and balance sheet, together with the CFO.
* Plan and raise capital: construction finance, lease rental discounting, refinancing, and in time equity from institutional or strategic partners.
* Bring in institutional-grade reporting: monthly MIS, asset-level accounts, valuations and budget-versus-actual reviews.
* Prepare the platform for a possible REIT, InvIT-style vehicle or platform deal, including due diligence, data rooms and investor relations.

**6. Legal, compliance and governance**

* Make sure title, approvals, leases and statutory filings are complete and clean across every asset.
* Oversee the legal and company secretarial function, including contracts, litigation and regulatory compliance.
* Set up the governance a professional company needs: a delegation-of-authority matrix, Board and committee processes, internal audit and risk management.
* Keep the separation between the business and the promoter family's other interests clear and documented.

**7. People and organisation**

* Design the organisation and hire, develop and keep a strong senior team.
* Build a performance culture with clear goals, reviews and incentives tied to business results.
* Plan succession for key roles and develop the next line of leaders.
* Lead a team that may grow to 150–200 people across leasing, operations, projects and support functions.

**8. Promoter and stakeholder partnership**

* Act as the promoters' trusted partner: keep them informed, seek their input on big decisions, and earn their confidence to delegate.
* Represent the company with occupiers, lenders, investors, government and industry bodies.
* Protect and build the group's reputation as a landlord of choice.

**Candidate profile**

The ideal candidate has already run a large commercial office platform, or a major part of one, with full accountability for results.

**Must have**

* 20+ years in real estate, with at least 5 years as CEO, COO, business head or head of a commercial office vertical.
* Direct accountability for 3.0–5.0 million sq ft or more of Grade-A office space, covering leasing, operations and asset value.
* A track record of leasing to multinational occupiers, and of renewals and pre-leasing at scale.
* A good working command of real estate finance: lease rental discounting, construction finance, valuations and investor reporting.
* Experience delivering new office buildings or campuses through partners and contractors.
* Experience of working with promoters or a Board, and of building governance and systems.

**Good to have**

* Time with a REIT, a real estate private equity platform or an institutional office owner in India, the Middle East or Asia.
* Experience of professionalising a promoter-led business, or of a first-CEO transition.
* Exposure to a REIT listing, platform deal or large asset sale.
* Sustainability and green-building leadership.
* Professional credentials such as MRICS or FRICS.

**Education**

* A degree in engineering, architecture, commerce or a related field.
* An MBA or equivalent from a leading institution is preferred; CA, CFA or CS qualifications are a plus.

**Leadership qualities**

This role needs an institution builder who is also comfortable getting into the detail.

* **Trusted partner to promoters.**
  Earns trust through openness and results; can disagree respectfully and still move decisions forward.
* **Commercial judgement.**
  Thinks in asset value, yield and risk, not only in occupancy and rent.
* **Builder of teams and systems.**
  Has hired senior leaders, set up processes and left organisations stronger than they found them.
* **Hands-on operator.**
  Knows the buildings, the occupiers and the numbers; visible on site and with key clients.
* **Integrity and governance.**
  Holds firm on compliance, transparency and fair dealing with occupiers, partners and staff.
* **Calm under pressure.**
  Handles vacancy shocks, project delays and market cycles with a steady hand.
* **Long-term commitment.**
  Wants to stay 5 years or more and build something that lasts.

**Compensation, location and how to apply**

The package is in the top quartile for CEOs in Indian commercial real estate. It combines fixed pay, an annual performance bonus and a long-term incentive tied to growth in asset value.

* **Location:**
  Bengaluru, with regular travel to the campuses and to meet occupiers and investors.
* **Relocation:**
  Full support for candidates moving from other Indian cities or returning from the Middle East or abroad.
* **How to apply:**
  Apply through this posting, or send your CV in confidence to the search team. Please include the size of the office portfolio you have managed (in million sq ft), your current role and your notice period.
* **Confidentiality:**
  All applications are handled in strict confidence. The client's identity is shared with shortlisted candidates only.

title: Sr Serviceability Engineer - Life Cycle Manager (LCM)
description:
**About Nutanix**
Nutanix is building a world where infrastructure is invisible, and organizations can focus on the work that matters. Our hybrid multicloud platform helps customers run applications and manage data across private, public, and distributed clouds with simplicity and control.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. The team is made up of engineers who improve product serviceability, diagnostics, reliability, and the overall customer experience.
  
  
Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate.
  
  
You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM), you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption.
  
  
LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues.
  
  
The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early.
* Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency.
* Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models.
* Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses.
* Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure.
* Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance.
* Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios.
* Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement.
* Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations.
* Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions.
* Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk.

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations.
* Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders.

Technical Requirements
  
  
Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows
  
  

* Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation.
* Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios.
* Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance.

Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies
  
  

* Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi.
* Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance.
* Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus.

Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting
  
  

* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis.
* Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns.
* Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred.
* Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation.

Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics
  
  

* Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows.
* Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues.
* Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios.

Serviceability and Quality Engineering
  
  

* Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products.
* Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk.
* Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution.
* Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms.
* Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments.
* Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing.
* Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards.
* Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution.
  
  
If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products.
  
  
Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Manager, Network and Infrastructure Reliability
description:
Five9 is a leader in AI-powered cloud contact center software, serving thousands of customers around the world and powering billions of customer interactions every year. We help enterprises deliver smarter customer experience with every interaction, turning every customer conversation into an opportunity to build trust, deepen loyalty, and drive growth. Our Genius CX platform combines deep contact center expertise with applied AI to deliver outcomes the business can measure.
  
  
Our team-first culture enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.
  
  
Five9 is rebuilding the operational leadership for its Network & Infrastructure team and needs a hands-on, senior technical manager to take direct ownership of the environment and the team executing the work.
  
  
The right candidate will have directly managed production networks at scale, led teams of engineers who build and maintain those systems, and successfully transitioned frontline operations from manual "click-ops" into automated, code-driven execution. If you have not personally managed engineering teams through this specific transition, this is not the right role.
  
  
Modernization is already underway, but the current engineering team is short-handed and lacks several critical skills. The person stepping into this role must stabilize daily operations quickly, assess the existing talent, and immediately begin rebuilding both the team and the operating workflows against clear, sprint-level, and measurable milestones.
  
  
This is a true player-coach role. You must stay close enough to the technical work to keep your engineering judgment sharp, maintain credibility with senior engineers, and be willing to set the standard by example on the keyboard when needed. At the same time, you must focus on building automated validation gates and upskilling your team so that you can step out of the daily critical path. Carrying a portion of the senior technical load to stabilize the team at the outset is expected; still operating as the primary technical bottle-neck six months in is a failure.
  
  
**Working Hours:**
9:00/9:30 PM – 6:00/6:30 AM IST (US business hours).
  
  
**What Success Looks Like In Your First 120 Days**

* A working map of the network and infrastructure estate across our DCs and our cloud footprint, plus a clear assessment of your team's capabilities and operational bottlenecks.
* A team skills assessment and a tactical execution plan that details how your team will transition from manual operations to infrastructure/network-as-code, automation, and drift control, balanced against current project deliverables.
* Key engineering hires onboarded successfully, with existing team members actively engaged in cross-training and upskilling programs.
* Early modernization wins visible in production, the on-call and incident load distributed fairly across the team, and you have successfully transitioned from tactical firefighting to guiding team execution.

**What You Bring To Five9**

* A track record of building and leading cohesive teams, raising engineering standards, and shifting daily operations from reactive to proactive, engineering-led execution.
* Experience stabilizing operations and guiding engineering teams through periods of technical change and modernization.
* Strong communication skills backed by operational data, clear risk articulation, and the ability to report measurable outcomes to department leadership.
* Proven ability to build trust, accountability, and a high-performance culture within your engineering team.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with software engineering, security, SRE, and product teams.
* Ability to mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, driving accountability while establishing clear ownership, operational discipline, and career growth pathways.
* Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in high-pressure production environments with competing operational demands.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity, align team goals with broader department objectives, and execute complex technical migrations.
* Effective conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills to align technical delivery with business needs.
* Strong operational judgment in network and infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Security Operations teams.

**What We Require**

* 7+ years of experience in network/infrastructure engineering, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams in mission-critical, multi-DC production environments.
* Deep technical background in modern DC networking, including OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, Cisco Nexus, and NX-OS.
* Experience managing infrastructure in a hybrid cloud environment, with a strong focus on supporting GCP workloads.
* Proven success guiding teams to build and adopt network automation and IaC using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience modernizing legacy environments by introducing configuration management, drift detection, and policy-based operations where they didn’t exist before.
* Strong understanding of network and infrastructure observability using tools such as ThousandEyes, Grafana, Loki, NetFlow, and Netscout to achieve a "single pane of glass" for system health.
* Experience supporting the underlying infrastructure needs of Kubernetes, AI, and GPU workloads.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.
  
  
Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.
  
  
View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

**Your Team, Your Impact**
At Marvell, we are looking for a Vulnerability Management Professional who will be instrumental in protecting the company’s digital assets. The individual shall come with proven strong technical competence and leadership capability to contribute towards the success of the enterprise-wide vulnerability management program. A Vulnerability Management Professional will be responsible for identification, assessment, prioritization, and drive mitigation of security weaknesses across an organization’s IT infrastructure, including cloud and on-premises systems. Key responsibilities include running vulnerability scans (e.g., Qualys, Tenable), analyzing risks, collaborating with IT teams to remediate threats, and automating security workflows
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Scanning & Detection: Conduct regular, scheduled, and on-demand vulnerability scans of servers, networks, applications, and cloud environments.
* Manage the regular scanning of Marvell’s infrastructure and applications to detect vulnerabilities.
* Tool Management: Configure, maintain, and tune security tools (e.g., Qualys, Rapid7, Defender VM).
* Analysis & Risk Assessment: Analyze scan results to distinguish actual threats from false positives and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business impact.
* Perform vulnerability risk profiling and prioritization of vulnerabilities.
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify weaknesses and potential threats to Marvell's systems and networks.
* Remediation Coordination: Work closely with system owners, IT teams, and engineers to ensure timely patching, configuration changes, or mitigation of vulnerabilities.
* Automation & Improvement: Implement automation for security workflows, data aggregation, and scanning to increase efficiency.
* Threat Intelligence: Research emerging threats and vulnerabilities to proactively update security controls.
* Stay up-to-date on emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices to continuously improve Marvell's security posture.
* Metrics & Reporting: Prepare detailed reports on vulnerability trends, remediation metrics, and compliance status for management and compliance teams.
* Leverage technology stack to report and manage the requirements of various metrics requested by different stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 6+ years of experience in vulnerability management.
* In-depth knowledge of common security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and mitigation techniques.
* Experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Qualys, Nessus, or similar.
* Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and software development processes.
* Industry certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, GIAC GWAPT, are highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

title: Enterprise Architect - Integration
description:

This role partners closely with business and technology teams to create a technology vision and ensure that resulting systems and solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, observable, reusable, and aligned with business capabilities. * Develop and implement best practices, standards, guardrails, and guidance, and coach technology teams on adoption.
* Make leadership recommendations regarding strategic architecture considerations related to business process design, workflow orchestration, integration modernization, and platform consolidation.

* Collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, operations, PMO, vendor, and third-party teams on architecture and design decisions.
* Respond to evolving security, privacy, resiliency, regulatory, and operational conditions; recommend and implement integration security guidelines.
* Design for reliability and operational excellence, including retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, dead-letter handling, error management, monitoring, alerting, and supportability.

* 7+ years of experience creating solution architectures and strategies across multiple architecture domains, including business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud, and security.

* Experience with cloud and hybrid integration patterns across SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, container platforms, on-premises systems, private connectivity, and enterprise network boundaries.
* Expertise in architectural cross-cutting concerns and trade-offs, including security, resiliency, performance, scalability, caching, observability, availability, operational support, and total cost of ownership.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, data contracts, canonical data models where appropriate, schema governance, transformation patterns, and integration data ownership.
* Experience with DevOps processes and tools, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality controls, deployment automation, environment strategy, and release management for integration solutions.
* Demonstrated competency applying architecture frameworks, architecture decision records, reference architectures, standards, governance processes, and modern delivery methods.
* Understanding of business process analysis, business process management, workflow orchestration, and process automation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex architecture topics for business, executive, and engineering audiences.
* Demonstrated continuous learning of new technologies and ability to translate emerging technology trends into practical enterprise architecture guidance.
* Self-motivated individual who thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services, retirement services, insurance, investments, asset management, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Strong experience with enterprise API management, AWS, system design.
* Advanced experience with Kafka, Confluent, AWS MSK, MQ, or other event streaming and enterprise messaging platforms.
* Experience with change data capture, event sourcing, stream processing, data replication, ETL/ELT, lakehouse integrations, metadata, data lineage, and operational-to-analytical data flows.
* Experience applying domain-driven design, bounded contexts, domain events, anti-corruption layers, and business capability mapping to integration architecture.
* Experience with platform engineering and self-service integration enablement, including reusable templates, golden paths, shared libraries, policy-as-code, developer tooling, and automated governance.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, ingress patterns, service mesh, cloud-native networking, and workload modernization.
* Experience evaluating and rationalizing integration platform portfolios, including iPaaS, API management, event broker, ESB, managed file transfer, B2B/EDI, workflow, and automation tools.
* Experience with enterprise architecture management tools, architecture repositories, capability maps, application portfolio management, and technology lifecycle management.
* Experience with cost optimization for integration platforms, cloud services, runtime consumption, licensing, API traffic, broker throughput, data egress, and platform consolidation.
* Experience enabling AI, automation, or agentic use cases through governed APIs, events, trusted data access, identity controls, and secure integration patterns.
* Relevant certifications such as TOGAF, cloud architect certifications, Kubernetes, security, API management, Kafka/event streaming, MuleSoft, Boomi, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or equivalent practical experience.

Leadership and Behavioral Skills
  
  

* People skills - interacts effectively with business stakeholders, technology teams, executives, vendors, and third-party integrators.
* Influence and motivation - evangelizes architecture direction, motivates teams, and drives adoption without relying solely on formal authority.
* Negotiation and facilitation - helps teams align on architecture decisions, trade-offs, prioritization, and implementation approaches.
